description:
Process Improvement Specialist, EU STEP FO
Job ID: 10560237 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU STEP Fulfillment Optimization (FO) team is looking for a Process Improvement Manager to own new initiatives/programs that fulfillment optimization for European network. In this role, you will evaluate and scale programs, build structured frameworks, size opportunities through data analysis, and managing stakeholder alignment to directly impact cost, speed, and customer experience.

Key job responsibilities

1. The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and critical thinker with advanced problem-solving, data analysis skills and can drive initiatives that benefit network cost and speed KPIs.
2. Identify and evaluate new programs requiring system (e.g. F2P) consideration and design structured approaches to improve their performance.
3. The candidate will be responsible for metrics and measurement across promise platforms and fulfillment optimization products to help evaluate inventory placement, fulfillment capabilities, and carrier capabilities — connecting these to objective metrics.
4. Your work will have a direct impact on Amazon's cost and customer speed — by ensuring that new program opportunities are prioritized and receive the structured ownership, stakeholder alignment, and analytical rigor they need to scale.
5. Manage end-to-end program execution: define timelines, key milestones, stakeholder alignment SLAs, and program-specific KPIs; coordinate cross-functional alignment to ensure programs progress on schedule.
6. Interact with global stakeholders across SCOT, Supply Chain, and Operations to identify EU-related programs and advocate the right tradeoffs at leadership level.
7. Build and maintain analytics to track program/KPI health, including opportunity sizing, what-if scenarios, and regular performance monitoring for launched programs.

About the team

EU STEP Fulfillment Optimization (FO) sits within EU STEP Transportation Network Optimization (TNO) and is responsible for optimizing order fulfillment across Amazon's European network. We launch new products, features, analytics, programs and decision frameworks that reduce cost while improving speed and reliability for customers, working closely with central teams like SCOT and EU OPS

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience managing projects
- Experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis, formulae, and data visualization
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership
- Relevant experience working in a supply project management or management consulting role

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in transportation and supply chain
- Experience in process improvement
- Experience in analytical tool building
- Understanding of SQL

title: Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU (m/f)
description:
Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU
Job ID: 10560220 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.
•Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU.
•Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles.
•This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team.
•Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects.

A day in the life

- Build relationships with our customers (shippers).
- Coach and mentor business developers within the team.
- Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs.
- Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions.

About the team

At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We're not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in team management
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Seven or more years of senior experience in a business management or operations management role.
- Experience in organizing and directing multiple teams and departments in a multi-matrixed environment.
- Experience in planning and leading strategic initiatives.
- Strong alignment with our leadership principles, particularly Customer Obsession, Think Big and Strive to be Earth's Best Employer.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements
- Experience in a high-performance start-up or incubation effort within a larger company
- Consulting experience, with a focus on operations management.

description:
Senior Financial Analyst, Worldwide Operations Security Finance, STEP Finance
Job ID: 10560262 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The WWOS Finance team supports Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) organization is dedicated on driving the Amazon flywheel. As part of the team, you will provide primary support to the WWOS leadership team to validation of project analysis, CAPEX methodologies, support directors in strategic alliance across the field network and deliver analysis to identify opportunities and benefits impacting OPEX or CAPEX execution across Amazon Network

WWOS Finance seeks a Sr. Financial Analyst to provide primary support to the overall Amazon cost structure and deliver financial insight on strategic investments to Senior Leadership. This role collaborates closely with a broad range of global finance and business leaders across Procurement, Field, Compliance, Risk and Insurance, and Operations teams. The role also partners with stakeholders across technical project and security teams, as well as FP&A. This role involves collecting, analyzing, and managing quantitative data and creating meaningful reports to track investment spend and program performance related to business improvement and cost reductions across the global supply chain. This role also maintains spend and savings measurements, and partners with stakeholders on the strategic input drivers that continuously improve the scalability, efficiency, and returns of program execution.

The successful candidate has demonstrated the following abilities: they influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment. They collaborate with executives and various business units across Amazon. You bring excellent verbal and written communication skills. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to innovate by building creative solutions with large-scale data mining tools, identifying the high-priority work and projects that maximize results for key stakeholders, and solving complex problems that effect company-wide strategic decisions.

Key job responsibilities

Use solid financial knowledge and business acumen to build financial models, interpret data, draw conclusions, and make recommendations that deliver results, drive improvements, and influence leaders throughout Amazon. These decisions can have global impact.

- Experience in forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and interpreting financial results
- Experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform business decisions with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
- Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships, or experience working with stakeholders

title: Principal Product Manager-Technical,Circular Economy,Extended Producer Responsbility mf
description:
Principal Product Manager - Technical, Circular Economy, Extended Producer Responsbility
Job ID: 10559192 | Amazon International Services SARL

Description

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon's transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon's most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity.

This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future.

Key job responsibilities

-Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.
-Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores.
Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams.
-Drive automation and simplification across Amazon's EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring.
-Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
-Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience technical product management
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Experience owning data-centric products
- Experience interpreting and communicating analytics

title: Safety Risk Engineer, WHS Design and Engineering (m/f)
description:
Safety Risk Engineer, WHS Design and Engineering
Job ID: 10559022 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.

A day in the life

You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing - helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team

The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic Qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in engineering (electrical, mechanical, civil, industrial engineering).
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2/C1), both written and verbal.
- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred Qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Membership of a professional body in the field of occupational health and safety.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- Experience working for/with a Notified or Approved Body for Machinery Safety.
- Formal training or certification in Machinery Safety (e.g. CMSE).
- NEBOSH certificate or equivalent.

title: Talent Intelligence Lead, EU Operations Leadership Development (m/f)
description:
Talent Intelligence Lead, EU Operations Leadership Development
Job ID: 10559058 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The EU Operations Leadership Development (LDEV) team builds mastery-level leadership skills, cohort-based growth programs, and career navigation for 17K+ tenured leaders across EU Operations. The impact of this work depends on how well it connects to what the business actually needs from its leaders.

We are seeking a Talent Intelligence Lead to own the strategic interface between LDEV and its two critical ecosystem partners: Talent Management (TM) and PXT. The core job is to understand the people priorities each business line is pursuing, build the trust and mechanisms that make TM and PXT active investors in what LDEV builds, and ensure LDEV is building against what the business needs.

This is a strategic role that requires both the ability to build trusted partnerships across organizational boundaries and the analytical instinct to interpret business and talent signals and translate them into a clear development agenda.

This position can be located in Luxembourg, London, or Barcelona.

Key job responsibilities

- Build and maintain working relationships with TM and PXT partners across business lines and regions
- Understand each business line's people priorities: e.g., capability gaps, population movement, succession needs
- Design the data-sharing model between LDEV and TM/PXT (what we share, what we receive back)
- Partner with PXT on GDPR and works council considerations for signal-based personalization
- Surface what TM and PXT are seeing and feed it into LDEV's planning rhythm (OP1/OP2, Talent Review, goal setting) so the roadmap stays current
- Identify misalignment between business needs and LDEV's offer, and surface gaps proactively
- Connect site-level PXT signals (organizational health, engagement, ER patterns) to LDEV's site leadership support strategy
- Write strategic narratives and present to Directors and VPs to secure alignment on the shared development agenda
- Spot opportunities where LDEV and a partner team could deliver something neither could alone, and build the case for it

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a related field
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience in an analytical tasks or projects, working with data
- Experience in the areas of management and leadership development, organization development, learning and development, group facilitation, training and training design, or equivalent business experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and implementing strategic initiatives
- Experience analyzing HR metrics and using data insights to drive business decisions
- Experience building a function, program, or operating model from scratch

title: Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE), EU Stores (m/f)
description:
Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE), EU Stores
Job ID: 10558898 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Are you passionate about using data to drive business decisions at massive scale? EU Vendor Intelligence is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to help power Amazon's growth and profitability across European markets.

In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. You will partner closely with Program Managers and Vendor Managers - not just answering their questions, but refining problems, recommending alternatives, and anticipating future analytical needs. You will own mid-to-large BI solutions end-to-end: from data modelling and pipeline design to dashboards and deep-dive analyses that drive real business decisions.

What you'll do:

• Design robust, maintainable data models and pipelines that power reporting and analytics for EU-wide retail programs
• Write advanced SQL and leverage scripting (e.g. Python) to solve difficult analytical problems and automate BI processes
• Build compelling visualizations and self-service reporting that reduce bottlenecks and put data directly into stakeholders' hands
• Develop a deep understanding of data lineage - from source systems through metrics aggregation to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (PMs, VMs, Data Engineers, other BIEs) to deliver solutions that balance business needs with technology constraints
• Improve code quality, optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability, and mentor teammates

This is a high-visibility role where your analytical rigor and business acumen will directly influence how Amazon grows selection and manages vendor relationships across Europe. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions - and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions - data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of data lineage: source systems, metrics aggregation logic, and how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon by stakeholders
• Partner with Program Managers, Vendor Managers, and cross-functional teams to refine business requirements, recommend analytical approaches, and anticipate future needs
• Build self-service reporting and visualization solutions that reduce bottlenecks and empower business partners to access data independently
• Ensure all solutions are efficient, testable, maintainable, well-documented, and resistant to data quality issues
• Optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability; establish data and reporting SLAs where appropriate
• Mentor junior team members and contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing a data pipeline you built, checking for anomalies before a weekly business review. By mid-morning, you're in a working session with a Vendor Manager, refining requirements for a new selection coverage analysis. After lunch, you're writing SQL to model vendor performance data, then building a QuickSight dashboard that lets Program Managers self-serve insights without waiting on ad-hoc requests. Later, you review a teammate's code, suggest a cleaner data model, and wrap up by automating a manual reporting step that's been slowing the team down.

About the team

The EU Vendor Intelligence Team builds BI solutions and capabilities that empower business users to self-serve their analytics and data needs across EU Stores. We support a wide variety of programs — from selection growth and vendor management to vendor education and vendor-facing chatbot tools. Our mission is to make data accessible, reliable, and actionable so that Program Managers and Vendor Managers can make faster, better-informed decisions at scale. We value automation over manual work, clean data models over quick fixes, and strong partnerships with the business teams we serve.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling

description:

title: Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) (m/f)
description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon's transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon's most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

Key job responsibilities

-Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.
-Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores.
Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams.
-Drive automation and simplification across Amazon's EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring.
-Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
-Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

title: Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) (m/f)
description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
description:
Applied Scientist, SCOT FO - SnT
Job ID: 10554093 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promises across hundreds of millions of packages daily? How does it decide how many trucks and how much labor are required to ship orders across the network?

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the optimization and forecasting science behind these decisions.

We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Barcelona (alternatively: Luxembourg or London) with a strong academic background in optimization, machine learning, and/or time-series forecasting.

• You will design and build state-of-the-art machine learning and optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at an unprecedented scale across two core scientific pillars:
• Large-Scale Optimization and Planning: Designing planning systems for order assignment and resource utilization, while balancing multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to enable controllers to steer millions of shipments per hour optimally.
• Demand Forecasting & Predictive ML: Developing time-series forecasts for customer demand, incorporating contextual information (weather, sales, order properties), and modeling uncertainty for core planning systems.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control
• Large-scale time-series forecasting (GenAI models, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty quantification)
• Causal inference (spatiotemporal causal modeling, offline policy evaluation)

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization and forecasting models for large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity, accuracy) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization or forecasting problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in building models for business application
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu

• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

title: Head of Channel Partnerships (m/f)
description:
Head of Channel Partnerships

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit an experienced Head of Channel Partnerships to join our global team.

Position Overview:  

Reporting to the Managing Director – Global Growth, the Head of Channel Partnerships will lead Sonata One's global channel partnership strategy function, driving commercial growth through the development of strategic relationships across the private markets ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity to join Sonata One at a pivotal stage in our growth journey as we invest significantly in building a world-class commercial organisation. You will play a key role in shaping our partnerships strategy, and helping expand Sonata One's presence across the global private markets industry.
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing and managing strategic partnerships that generate new commercial opportunities, strengthen long-term client relationships and expand Sonata One's market presence. Working closely with the New Business team, Marketing, Product, Technology and Operations, you will help deliver Sonata One's ambitious commercial growth strategy while ensuring our partner ecosystem continues to create value for clients around the world.

Responsibilities:  

Revenue Generation

• Develop and execute the global channel partnership strategy to support Sonata One's commercial growth objectives.  
• Identify opportunities to generate new revenue through strategic partnerships, cross-selling and partner-led opportunities.  
• Work closely with the New Business team to maximise commercial opportunities generated through partner relationships.  
• Support joint go-to-market initiatives and marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness and generate qualified opportunities.  

Strategic Partnership Development

• Identify, evaluate and establish new strategic partnerships across the private markets ecosystem.  
• Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned to Sonata One's commercial objectives.  
• Expand Sonata One's partner network across key global markets.  
• Assess prospective partners based on market reach, client base, strategic fit and long-term commercial value.  

Relationship Management

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organisations.  
• Act as the primary executive contact for strategic partners.  
• Develop engagement plans that maximise partner success and long-term collaboration.  
• Proactively resolve issues and identify opportunities to strengthen relationships.  

Performance & Growth

• Establish KPIs to measure partnership success.  
• Monitor pipeline performance, commercial outcomes and partner engagement.  
• Use market insights and performance data to continuously improve partnership strategies.  
• Deliver accurate commercial forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.  

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing to improve awareness, engagement and partner enablement.  
• Work closely with Product and Technology teams to ensure partner feedback informs future product development.  
• Collaborate with Legal to support commercial agreements and partnership governance where required.  
 

Compensation:
• Industry leading base salary - EUR 130,000 - 200,000 depending on experience.

Qualifications:  
 
• Proven experience in a senior partnerships, business development or commercial leadership role.  
• Demonstrable success developing strategic partnerships within fintech, financial services, fund services or private markets.  
• Strong understanding of the private markets ecosystem, including fund managers, institutional investors and service providers.  
• Existing network across the private markets industry would be highly advantageous.  
• Experience leading and developing high-performing commercial or relationship management teams.  
• Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.  
• Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute partnership strategies.  
• Analytical mindset with experience using commercial data to drive decision making.  
• Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.  
• Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce would be advantageous.  
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.  

Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Everyone has an important role to fulfil, and your contribution will be an integral part of our success story.   
  
Benefits:   

• Life Insurance – Peace of mind for you and your loved ones 
• Income Protection – Financial support when you need it most 
• Hybrid Working – Supporting work/Life Balance 
• Annual Leave – With extra days that grow the longer you're with us 
• Pension Scheme – Employee matched helping you plan confidently for the future 
• Employee Assistance Program – Confidential, 24/7 support for life's ups and downs 
• Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave – Because family matters 
• Career Training & Development – Ongoing learning opportunities to help you grow 
• Paid Volunteering Day – Take time to give back to causes you care about 
• Cycle to work Scheme – Employees can benefit from significant tax savings on bicycles and cycling equipment
• Work From Anywhere – Choose your backdrop

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Responsibilities may include:

- Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
- Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
- Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
- Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )

- Developing dashboards and insight products
- Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL

Preferred Qualifications

title: Inventory Planner, AMXL Supply Chain (m/f)
description:
Inventory Planner, AMXL Supply Chain
Job ID: 10518468 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges that directly impact customer experience? Do you thrive in a role that combines analytical rigor with hands-on execution? Join Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) as an Inventory Planner where you'll define and lead placement initiatives that optimize our inventory network.

This role offers an exciting blend of analytics, execution, automation, and stakeholder management. You'll work on optimization exercises that improve how we position inventory across our network, ensuring customers receive their large items efficiently. Your work will directly influence operational performance and customer satisfaction, making a measurable impact across the entire customer journey.

Key job responsibilities

- Define and lead the execution of placement initiatives that optimize inventory positioning across the AMXL network
- Design and implement automation solutions to streamline inventory planning processes and improve operational efficiency
- Conduct complex optimization exercises analyzing inventory flows, demand patterns, and capacity constraints to drive data-informed decisions
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including operations, transportation, and fulfillment teams to align on placement strategies and resolve inventory challenges
- Develop and maintain analytical models and tools that enable proactive inventory management and support strategic planning initiatives

A day in the life

You'll start your day analyzing inventory performance metrics and identifying opportunities for optimization. You might spend time building automation tools to streamline repetitive processes, then shift to collaborating with operations partners on implementing a new placement strategy. Throughout the day, you'll tackle customer-facing challenges that require deep analysis, run optimization models to test different scenarios, and work with stakeholders to execute improvements that enhance the customer experience.

About the team

AMXL is Amazon's first true end-to-end organization for extra-large items, with visibility and impact across every mile of the customer journey. From the moment an order is placed to final delivery, our team orchestrates the complex logistics of getting bulky items to customers efficiently.

Our team culture thrives on knowledge sharing, mutual support, and continuous learning. We tackle unique challenges in the large-item space, innovating solutions that haven't been solved elsewhere. You'll work alongside passionate professionals who are committed to improving operations while supporting each other's growth and development.

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.

Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

After our auctions kicks off at 06:00 a.m., you will make sure that all orders can be transported all over the world by noon. Of course, you will not need to do this all by yourself: You will work together with a fun and diverse team of around 150 co-workers! Your work includes the following tasks: -
Your shift starts at 06:00 a.m., after which you pick up an empty cart. This cart needs to be filled with one of our customers' orders; -

Using your small, electric truck (no license required), you drive to the specified location; -
You move the ordered flowers or plants onto your cart. Once full, this cart is ready for further shipment; -

description:

Job Description
Jouw nieuwe werkgever is een bekend familiebedrijf met een sterke focus op logistiek binnen de horeca-, food- en retailsector. Vanuit de locatie in Hedel verzorgt het team dagelijks de distributie van allerlei horecaproducten naar klanten in heel Nederland. Met een platte organisatiestructuur en een no-nonsense mentaliteit is dit een werkgever waar je je snel thuis voelt. Als C chauffeur horecadistributie ben je hier geen nummer, maar een belangrijke collega. Zo ziet jouw werkdag eruit Je begint je dag in Hedel, waar je jouw wagen ophaalt en de route alvast bekijkt. Als C chauffeur horecadistributie vervoer je diverse horecagoederen naar klanten in de regio. Het laden, vervoeren en lossen van de goederen doe je op een veilige en efficiënte manier. Je rijdt vaak vaste routes, waardoor je veel dezelfde klanten spreekt. Gemiddeld bezoek je 10 klanten per dag, lekker afwisselend dus. Wil je af en toe in het weekend werken? Dat kan in overleg. Je start tussen 6.00 en 7.00 uur en bent rond 17.00 uur weer klaar. Wat valt 'r te halen? Een salaris tussen €17,99 en €20,24 bruto per uur (TLN schaal D3 t/m D6), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring. Overwerktoeslag van 130% als je meer dan 40 uur werkt. Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer. 25 vakantiedagen per jaar om lekker op vakantie te gaan. 8,33% vakantiegeld. Pensioenopbouw via Stipp. Mogelijkheid tot een vast contract bij goed functioneren. Groei door binnen een groot en stabiel familiebedrijf. Dit ben jij Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs C, een bestuurderskaart en Code 95 (of je bent bereid deze te halen). Je spreekt Nederlands of Engels en woont al in Nederland. De regio Hedel ken je goed of je woont in de buurt. Fysiek werk is voor jou geen probleem en je werkt graag zelfstandig. title: Consultant für Projektmanagement Healthcare  - Business Consulting (w/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
Requisition ID: 1609987

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Als Teil unseres HealthCare Teams in Frankfurt/Main, Berlin, Hamburg, Stuttgart, Köln, Düsseldorf oder München berätst du unsere Kund:innen im Rahmen von komplexen Transformationsprojekten im Gesundheitswesen aus unternehmerischer und ganzheitlicher Perspektive mit innovativen Ansätzen. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:

- Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Kundenanalysen sowie SWOT-Analysen und Ableitung von strategischen Implikationen für die Kund:innen im Kontext technologischer Innovationen und regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen des Gesundheitswesens
- Entwicklung von Digital Strategie und neuen strategischen Stoßrichtungen als Basis für die Positionierung im Wettbewerbsumfeld und Ableitung von Transformationsvorhaben im Kontext der Digitalisierung und Kundenzentrierung
- Entwicklung von neuen (Geschäfts-)Potenzialen sowie Ideen für Produkte, Services und Prozesse durch iteratives kundenzentriertes Prototyping sowie Erstellung von Produktvisionen
- Mitverantwortliche Steuerung von Strategie- und Transformationsprojekten in Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern
- Nutzung einer Bandbreite an Methoden vom Projektmanagement bis Design Thinking, Scrum, SAFE und Lean Startup

Dein Skillset

- Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Gesundheitsökonomie, Digital Health oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung
- Erste Erfahrungen (mind. Praktika oder Werkstudierendentätigkeiten) in der Beratungstätigkeit in Organisationen des Gesundheitswesens, wie Krankenhäuser oder Krankenkassen
- Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch auf C1-Niveau sowie eine Reisebereitschaft von mind. 50%

- Agil:  Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
- Neugierig:  Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
- Teamorientiert : Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.

Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. title: Carpenter
description:
At a precast concrete element factory in the Netherlands

Work tasks: The main responsibility is the production and assembly of wooden frames at the Constar Prefab B.V. factory.
The work includes, among other things: * Manufacturing wooden structures and frames; * Working according to technical drawings; * Measuring, cutting and assembling components; * Ensuring a high-quality and accurate result; * Proper use and handling of tools and materials; * Working as part of a team in the factory's daily production process. The position requires good manual skills, accuracy and the ability to work independently according to provided drawings and instructions.

We offer: €18 net per hour – the employee receives €18 net for every hour worked.
In addition: * Free accommodation – accommodation is provided in a large and comfortable private house. * The usual value of the accommodation is more than €950 per month, but it is provided free of charge to the employee. * Free transportation to and from work – a minibus is provided for commuting. * Full-time employment – normally approximately 45–50 hours per week. * Possibility of overtime – including, in some cases, Saturdays, providing an opportunity to increase your income. * Permanent employment contract – Aalto Eesti OÜ concludes the employment contract with the employee, who will work as a temporary agency worker at Constar Prefab B.V.

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate who has:
* At least 2 years of experience as a carpenter or in a similar position; * Good knowledge of woodworking and the construction of wooden structures; * Ability to read technical drawings; * Good manual skills and technical understanding; * A responsible and precise approach to work; * Willingness to work full-time in the Netherlands; * A strong work ethic and a reliable attitude as a team member. English language skills: at least B1 level spoken and A2 level written. Russian language skills are preferred. Applicants must be Estonian citizens or holders of a valid European Union passport.

Option to work from home: No

title: Persoonlijk begeleider in Nederweert
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor WonenPlus een Persoonlijk begeleider- Echte zorg begint met écht zien in Nederweert

Echte zorg ontstaat wanneer mensen elkaar écht zien. Niet vanuit regels of protocollen, maar vanuit oprechte aandacht. Bij ons krijgen professionals het vertrouwen én de verantwoordelijkheid om te doen wat nodig is. Ze denken niet vóór mensen, maar mét mensen.

En dat zie je terug in alles wat we doen. In onze diverse woonvormen en dagbesteding verspreid over Limburg, creëren ruim 230 bevlogen medewerkers op 13 locaties ruimte voor zo’n 230 cliënten. Ruimte om te leven. Ruimte om zichzelf te zijn.

Binnen team Nederweert hebben we plek voor een Persoonlijk begeleider, uren in overleg

Wat ga je doen?  

Jij ondersteunt hen bij het dagelijks leven en helpt ze de dingen die nodig zijn om de regie op het eigen leven zoveel mogelijk te behouden ondanks de beperkingen.

Je biedt structuur en aandacht. Je biedt de juiste ondersteuning die bijdraagt aan een waardig en zinvol leven.

Naast jouw inzet voor de groep, werk je als persoonlijk begeleider ook een-op-een met een van de cliënten.

Samen met hem werk je aan zijn persoonlijke doelen. Ook ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor familie en ketenpartners, samen met de teamleider en gedragswetenschapper.  

Binnen dit team worden slaap- en onregelmatige diensten gedraaid.

Wie zoeken wij:

- Iemand die ervaring heeft in het begeleiden van mensen met een beperking.

- Iemand die ervaring heeft met gedragsproblematieken en hiernaar kan handelen. Doelgroep is bekend met autisme, psychiatrische en verslavingsproblematieken.

- Iemand die opgeleid is op MMZ4 of soortgelijk

- Iemand die kritisch kijkt naar eigen handelen en het handelen in het team

- Iemand die onze kernwaardes: vertrouwen, respect en eigenaarschap onderstreept

title: Projectleider
description:
Wat maakt deze functie anders?

In deze functie ben je veel meer dan alleen projectleider. Je bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij uiteenlopende renovatie-, verduurzamings- en verbouwprojecten. Je schakelt tussen opdrachtgevers, bewoners, uitvoerders en projectteams en krijgt veel vrijheid om projecten zelfstandig te begeleiden. Door de afwisseling tussen kantoor en bouwplaats én de diversiteit aan projecten is geen werkdag hetzelfde.

Jouw werkzaamheden

· Begeleiden van renovatie-, verduurzamings- en verbouwprojecten.

· Coördineren van kleine en middelgrote bouwprojecten.

· Opstellen en bewaken van de projectplanning.

· Medeverantwoordelijk zijn voor de financiële bewaking van projecten.

· Bijdragen aan de werkvoorbereiding en succesvolle realisatie van projecten.

· Toezien op kwaliteit, planning en voortgang.

Wat breng je mee?

· Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Bouwkunde of een vergelijkbaar werk- en denkniveau.

· Meerdere jaren ervaring als Projectleider Bouw, Projectleider Renovatie, Projectmanager Bouw, Senior Werkvoorbereider, Uitvoerder of een vergelijkbare bouwkundige functie.

· Ervaring met renovatie-, onderhouds- of verduurzamingsprojecten.

· Cijfermatig inzicht en organisatorisch sterk.

· Je werkt zelfstandig, bent flexibel en neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid.

· Je bent communicatief sterk en schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende partijen.
