title: Product Designer - Womenswear Knitwear
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description:
Job Description

Design isn’t just what we do—it’s who we are. At & Other Stories, you’ll create collections that set trends and tell stories. From first sketch to final garment, your vision will shape the future of fashion and inspire a global audience.

As a Product Designer in Knitwear, you will transform creative concepts into outstanding products that align with our brand identity and meet customer expectations. You’ll combine design expertise with technical knowledge to deliver collections that are both innovative and commercially relevant.

Your Responsibilities:

What you will do…

    Design and develop products for seasonal collections, ensuring alignment with brand DNA and creative vision
    Translate trends into key silhouettes, fabrics, colours, and details
    Identify yarns, colours, silhouettes and details that are in line with set seasonal trend and design direction. Plan a coordinated assortment with focus on new, relevant and commercial products
    Participate in fittings and ensure garments meet our high standards of silhouette and design with the right timing, following up closely throughout the development process
    Conduct ongoing research and analysis of fashion trends, customer behaviour, and market movements
    Take ownership of timelines and drive the design process forward with initiative and creativity
    Contribute to assortment creation and curation, ensuring collections are commercially viable and aligned with growth and profitability goals.
    Collaborate closely with design leads, print, buyer, and production teams to deliver cohesive collections.
    Provide informal leadership, leading and developing Junior Designers. Confidently communicate your design and product presentation in a clear, compelling, and inspiring way

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will collaborate daily with Designers, Product Developers, Atelier Designers and the wider Assortment and Buying teams. You’ll be part of a design team of around 15 within a broader group of approximately 25 colleagues, working closely to shape a cohesive knitwear offer.

In this collaborative environment, you’ll share ideas, build on team expertise and work with internal partners and external suppliers to develop high-quality, commercially relevant products from concept through to final delivery.

Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

    Degree in Fashion Design or a related field
    Proven experience in knitwear design within a fashion retail environment
    Strong technical knowledge of knitwear construction, including yarns, gauges, and knitting techniques (e.g. fully fashioned, circular knit, jacquard)
    Solid understanding of garment construction, materials, and product development processes
    Experience in building and developing commercial assortments in line with brand direction
    Strong ability to research, interpret, and apply trends within a retail context
    High level of design sensibility aligned with brand aesthetics
    Proficiency in design software (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
    Confident in working cross-functionally with buying, production, and suppliers
    Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

And people who are…

    Creative and detail-oriented with a passion for fashion.
    Visionary and curious – eager to push boundaries and explore new ideas.
    Communicative and collaborative – building alignment across teams.
    Resilient and adaptable – thriving in a fast-paced environment with tight timelines.
    Open to feedback and innovation, with a strong focus on sustainability and commercial impact.

Additional Information

This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office in Stockholm.

If you feel this opportunity is exciting feel free to apply by sending in your CV and Portfolio in English before 15th October. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

Please note that we may take the ad down before the application deadline if we receive a high volume of qualified applications—so we encourage you to apply early.

We value collaboration and believe great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office based, with four days per week on site. One day per week, you may work remotely.

Please note that this position is offered on a local contract, and you must have the legal right to work in Sweden before applying.  



WHO WE ARE

& Other Stories is a modern fashion brand that tells expressive stories. Designed for everyday living – with its excitement, curiosity and imperfections – our clothes empower those who think differently. Learn more about & Other Stories here.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this, & Other Stories-based colleagues also receive:

    30 days holiday
    A collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
    Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
    Benify Benefits Portal

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We look forward to hearing from you

title: Concept Artist
description:
Do you have an eye for detail and a passion for creating awesome character design concepts, magical environment concepts and whatever is needed to enhance game experience? Are you excited about crafting vibrant visuals for mobile games that captivate millions of players?

As a Concept Artist at Snowprint, you’ll have a broad role with plenty of room to influence the visual direction of our new game project. You’ll mainly work on character and outfit concepts, but also contribute to props, items, environments, key art, and whatever else is needed to bring the game’s visual world together.

You’ll be part of a small team where your ideas and perspective matter. You’ll work closely with the Art Director, other artists, designers, and developers, with the freedom to take ownership of your work and find solutions rather than simply working from a list of tasks.

At Snowprint, we believe that kindness, curiosity, collaboration, and a shared passion for making great games are key to creating a good place to work and great games.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll primarily create concepts for characters and their outfits, developing ideas that can be translated into 3D models and eventually brought into the game. You’ll work from early ideas through to more detailed concepts and turnarounds, making sure your designs communicate the character clearly and give the 3D team what they need to take them further.

You’ll also create key art and title screens, as well as concepts for props, items, environments, and other visual elements when needed. The role gives you the opportunity to work across different types of concept art and contribute to the overall visual quality of the game.

You’ll work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the art team, sharing work early, discussing ideas, and responding to feedback throughout the process. You’ll be encouraged to explore different approaches, adapt your style to the needs of the game, and keep moving rather than over-polishing before getting feedback.

Is this you?

    

You’re an experienced Concept Artist with professional experience working on at least one released game. Experience from a stylized, fantasy, or high-fidelity game is particularly relevant.

    

You have a strong understanding of character design, including anatomy, proportions, clothing, poses, lighting, composition, mood, and surfaces. You know how to make designs feel visually interesting while still having a clear function and purpose.

    

You understand the path from concept to 3D. You know how to create clear character turnarounds and other concepts that give 3D artists what they need to build and implement the asset.

    

You’re adaptable and comfortable working within an established art direction. You can adjust your style to what the game needs and are comfortable working across characters, props, environments, and key art.

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio

    

Strong character / creature appeal and design fundamentals

    

Dynamic / interesting character presentation

    

Work samples showing confidence in human and animal anatomy

    

A strong understanding of light and material behaviour

    

Clear character sheets for 3D artists

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, with a hybrid working model. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction. Other days, you can work from wherever you feel most productive. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably.

We’re unable to support relocation for this position, so you need to be based in Stockholm, Sweden.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals working together in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment, while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance.

Our games include Legends of Solgard, Rivengard, and Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus. We care about making great games and creating an environment where people can do their best work together.

For more information on Snowprint Studios, visit our website and follow us on social media.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace.

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Juniora Konsulter Technology Risk | Assurance |  Göteborg
description:
Are you ready to shape the future with confidence?



Som junior konsult inom Technology Risk hos oss på EY blir du del av ett team i gränslandet mellan teknik, affär och risk. Du får snabbt arbeta med att hjälpa kunder säkra informationshantering och möta regulatoriska krav. Du utvecklar kompetens inom IT-revision, internkontroll och cybersäkerhet – med stöd från erfarna kollegor i en inkluderande kultur.



Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad inom systemvetenskap, cybersäkerhet, teknik eller ekonomi och som vill påbörja din karriär hos oss i augusti 2027 – med möjlighet till tidigare startdatum. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm eller Göteborg.





Möjligheten: ditt nästa äventyr väntar på dig



Du kommer att arbeta med en varierad kundportfölj inom både privat och offentlig sektor, och delta i nationella såväl som internationella projekt.



Som konsult blir du en nyckelperson i rådgivning kring IT-internkontroll, revision, regulatorisk efterlevnad, IT-styrning och cybersäkerhet. Du genomför riskanalyser, utvärderar IT-processer och föreslår förbättringar.



I en dynamisk miljö hanterar du frågor som: Vilka risker medför AI och automatisering? Hur tillförlitliga är molntjänstleverantörers kontroller? Hur skyddas kunddata hos tredje part? Din analytiska förmåga är avgörande för att möta dessa utmaningar och leverera säkra lösningar.





Kvalifikationer:



    Relevant universitetsexamen (exempelvis IT, informationssäkerhet, systemvetenskap, datateknik, civilingenjör, jurist, cybersäkerhet eller civilekonom)

    Hög språklig nivå i tal och skrift, både på svenska och engelska





Meriterande:



    Masterexamen är meriterande

    Relevant IT-teknisk kompetens (exempelvis hantering av affärssystem, operativsystem, databaser) eller kunskap om IT-risk och informationssäkerhet (t.ex. CoBiT, ITIL, ISO27001 och NIST) är meriterande
    



Som person:



    Intresse och förståelse för IT-risker och teknik

    Lyhörd lagspelare med ambitionen att vara högpresterande

    Kommunikativ med god förmåga att arbeta i team

    Nyfiken och entreprenörsdriven

    En fallenhet för att hantera förändring
    Detaljorienterad

    Ansvarstagande och proaktiv





Vad vi erbjuder dig



    Kontinuerligt lärande: Du utvecklar tankesätt och färdigheter som hjälper dig att navigera in i framtiden.

    Transformativt ledarskap: Vi ger dig insikter, coachning och självförtroende för att bli den ledare som världen behöver.

    Inkluderande kultur: Du kommer att accepteras för den du är och få möjlighet att använda din röst för att hjälpa andra att hitta sin.

    På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompentens utvecklas i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här.





Är du redo att ”Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Skicka in din ansökan innehållande CV, personligt brev och betyg, senast den 23 Oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Maria Romanova (Mariia.Romanova@se.ey.com). Frågor om processen? Mejla Klara.Stenqvist@se.ey.com.



Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.



På EY värdesätter vi mångfald och uppmuntrar ansökningar från individer från olika bakgrunder. Om du har frågor, behöver stöd, eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte på att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Expression of Interest  Freelance International Recruiter
description:
Remote | Flexible | Commission-based

Do you enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and helping others take the step towards living and working abroad?

Jobs By Nordics is looking to connect with motivated Freelance International Recruiters who want to work remotely and help candidates find exciting job opportunities across Europe.

We recruit multilingual talent for international companies across Europe and are continuously interested in connecting with people who can help us reach more candidates and make great hires.

Right now, we are especially interested in recruiters who speak Danish, German or Dutch, as we have a strong demand for candidates within these markets.

About Jobs By Nordics

Jobs By Nordics is a recruitment agency specialising in connecting multilingual talent with international employers across Europe.

We help Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Dutch and German speakers find opportunities abroad, with many of our positions located in destinations such as Greece, Spain and Cyprus.

Our vacancies are mainly within:

    Customer Service
    

    Technical Support
    

    Sales
    

    Content Moderation
    

    Travel & Tourism

For many of our candidates, accepting a job through us means more than changing employer. It can mean moving to a new country, meeting new people and starting an entirely new chapter in life.

As a recruiter, you will be an important part of making that happen.

The role

As a Freelance International Recruiter, you will manage your candidates throughout the recruitment journey – from finding and contacting them to supporting them through the recruitment process and towards their relocation and new job abroad.

Your responsibilities can include:

    Finding and attracting candidates through social media, job platforms, your own network and other creative sourcing channels
    

    Proactively reaching out to potential candidates
    

    Screening candidates and understanding their motivation, experience and preferences
    

    Matching candidates with suitable opportunities
    

    Presenting positions and relocation opportunities to candidates
    

    Preparing and supporting candidates through assessments and interviews
    

    Following up and keeping candidates engaged throughout the recruitment process
    

    Supporting candidates ahead of their relocation and job start
    

    Keeping candidate information and recruitment statuses updated

You will have the freedom to develop your own ways of finding candidates while working with the vacancies and recruitment opportunities available through Jobs By Nordics.

Who are we looking for?

First and foremost, we are looking for people who are proactive, independent and good with people.

You should enjoy communicating with new people and be comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting for candidates to come to you.

Fluent English is required.

At the moment, we are particularly interested in people who also speak:

    Danish
    

    German
    

    Dutch

Previous experience within recruitment or sales is an advantage, but it is not necessarily a requirement. The right personality, motivation and ability to connect with people are equally important.

We believe you could be a great fit if you:

    Are comfortable approaching and communicating with new people
    

    Are proactive and enjoy finding your own ways to reach candidates
    

    Have a good understanding of social media and online communities
    

    Are organised and good at following up
    

    Can work independently and take responsibility for your own results
    

    Enjoy working with people from different countries and cultures
    

    Have lived or worked abroad, or have a genuine interest in international opportunities
    

    Are motivated by a performance-based way of working

Work remotely – with freedom and responsibility

The collaboration is fully remote, giving you the freedom to work from wherever suits you.

As a freelancer, you decide how you organise your working day and how you approach your candidate sourcing. At the same time, successful recruitment requires consistency, good follow-up and the ability to take ownership of your candidates throughout the process.

Jobs By Nordics provides access to recruitment opportunities, information about the positions and employers, and the tools and support needed to successfully guide candidates through the process.

Commission-based freelance collaboration

The role is commission-based, meaning your earnings are directly connected to your successful recruitments.

This is a freelance collaboration rather than an employment position. You therefore need to have your own registered company or equivalent business structure that allows you to invoice Jobs By Nordics for your services.

As an independent freelancer, you are responsible for managing and complying with the tax, social security, VAT, insurance and other applicable legal requirements in the country where you operate.

Why work with Jobs By Nordics?

You get the opportunity to combine recruitment with the freedom of working independently and remotely.

You can focus on what recruiters do best – finding great people, building relationships and making successful placements – while recruiting for real opportunities with international employers across Europe.

And perhaps most importantly, the people you recruit are often making a major life decision.

You are not simply helping someone find another job.

You might be helping them start a new life abroad.

Interested?

We would love to hear from you.

Send us your Expression of Interest and tell us a little about yourself, the languages you speak, your background and why you believe you would be successful as a Freelance International Recruiter.

We are especially interested in hearing how you would approach finding and engaging candidates for international opportunities.

Join our freelance recruiter network and help more people discover their next opportunity abroad.

title: Family medicine specialist opportunities across Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time.

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: Master Thesis: Productivity Enhancement of PBF-EB Through Porous Printing,
description:
Project Description
Powder Bed Fusion by Electron Beam (PBF-EB) normally aims to produce components with high density. However, productivity may be improved by creating only a gas-tight outer shell around a sintered or semi-melted porous core, followed by Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP). In PBF-EB, internal pores are formed under vacuum, which is favorable for pore closure during HIP provided that the shell remains gas-tight. Previous studies in both PBF-EB and PBF-LB have demonstrated the feasibility of shell-core concepts, although validation for more complex geometries remains limited.[1]­,[2] If HIP is already required, the approach reduces energy input, build time, cost, and evaporation of sensitive alloying elements. The key challenges are to identify stable process parameters, verify shell integrity, and quantify porosity, densification, and dimensional shrinkage.
  
This master thesis will focus primarily on experimental work in the PBF-EB printer. The student will evaluate a limited set of process parameters to produce test parts with a dense shell and a porous sintered or semi-melted core. Samples will be characterized before and after HIP to determine process stability, shell integrity, density, pore morphology, microstructure, and dimensional change. The work will generate an initial dataset for shrinkage compensation and include a limited finite element modelling (FEM) task to predict and compensate shrinkage.
  
The aim is to determine whether a shell-core PBF-EB strategy can shorten build time while producing preforms suitable for HIP consolidation, and to establish an initial method for compensating predictable shrinkage. The scope is sized for one 30-credit master thesis: one material, simple coupon geometries, a few iterative test prints, 1-2 HIP cycles, basic sample characterization, FEM shrinkage modelling, and printing a more complex shape to evaluate the developed model and process parameters. Full constitutive model development, extensive mechanical qualification, and industrial-scale validation are outside the thesis scope.

Scope and Objectives
The student will:

    Review PBF-EB shell-core strategies, HIP densification, shrinkage compensation and relevant FEM approaches.
    Define a feasible specimen design with an airtight shell and a sintered and/or semi-melted core.
    Screen a small set of printer variables.
    Produce a dense reference condition and a number of shell-core conditions with varying initial density levels.
    Characterise shell integrity, density, pore morphology, dimensions, and microstructure before HIP.
    HIP and quantify densification and dimensional shrinkage.
    Create an initial shrinkage-compensation relationship based on FEM modelling.
    Estimate potential build-time and cost benefits relative to the dense reference using recorded machine data.

Expected outcomes

    A documented PBF-EB process window for manufacturing airtight shell-core structures with porous interiors.
    A dataset containing process parameters, density measurements, pore characteristics, shell integrity assessments, 3D scan dimensional measurements before and after HIP.
    Quantification of HIP-induced densification, shrinkage, and geometric deviation for selected shell-core conditions.
    A simplified FEM-based workflow for shrinkage prediction calibrated using experimental results.
    Validation of the methodology on a more complex geometry representative of practical applications.
    An optional comparison between PBF-EB and PBF-LB shell-core structures.
    An indicative assessment of productivity and cost benefits compared with conventional dense PBF-EB manufacturing.
    Recommendations for future work involving more complex geometries, wider process windows, and more advanced modelling approaches.

The student will refine the experimental matrix and FEM together with supervisors and colleagues at Swerim. A successful thesis is expected to prioritize robust PBF-EB processing, verification of shell airtightness, reliable HIP densification, and accurate shrinkage measurements. The FEM work will focus on practical shrinkage prediction and model calibration. Comparison with PBF-LB material is considered a stretch objective and will be included only if resources and project timing permit.

Qualifications
Master’s student in materials science, mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field. A strong understanding of physical metallurgy and an interest in hands-on experimental work, systematic data analysis, and problem-solving are essential. Access to FEM software such as Abaqus or COMSOL through the university is required because Swerim has limited number of software licenses. Practical experience with metal powder bed fusion (PBF-EB/LB), metallurgical lab preparation, microscopy, finite element modeling (FEM), metrology, or Python/MATLAB is advantageous but not required.

Project time
The project is intended for a master thesis (30 credits). The planned start is January 2027, or another date agreed with the selected student.

Further information
This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp).

For further information please contact: Emil Strandh, emil.strandh@swerim.se

Application
Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in English or Swedish. Latest date for application is 20th of November. You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means we can fill the position before the deadline.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer
description:
Help us build the commercial engine that powers growth across Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands.

﻿About the Role

As Bjorn Lunden continues to grow across Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands, we are looking for a Go-to-Market Engineer to join our Commercial Development team.

You will play a key role in helping us build a more scalable, efficient and data-driven commercial organisation.

In this role, you will be responsible for building, optimizing and scaling the systems, processes and automation that enable our commercial organisation to perform at its best. You will own HubSpot and our commercial technology stack while working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Commercial Development to create a more efficient, scalable and data-driven way of working.

You will work at the intersection of technology, data and commercial operations, helping us continuously develop and improve our commercial operating model across Sweden, Denmark and the Netherlands.

You will have the opportunity to shape how our commercial teams work, how we leverage technology and automation, and how we build scalable commercial capabilities across the Group.

You will help shape customer journeys, strengthen commercial processes and identify new opportunities to leverage AI and automation. This is a highly collaborative role where you will partner with teams and stakeholders across countries and functions to continuously improve how we work and grow.

Your main responsibilities include:

    Owning and developing HubSpot and the commercial technology stack
    Building workflows, automation and scalable commercial processes
    Driving marketing automation, lifecycle management and lead flows
    Ensuring data quality, governance and reliable commercial insights
    Identifying and implementing AI and automation opportunities
    Partnering with Commercial Development, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success to continuously improve the commercial operating model
    Leading system, process and transformation initiatives across markets
    Ensuring new systems, automation and ways of working are successfully adopted and embedded across commercial teams

About You

You are a curious problem solver who enjoys understanding how systems, processes and people work together. You are driven by finding smarter ways of working and get energy from turning ideas into practical solutions that create real business value.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy working at the intersection of technology and business. Whether you are improving a process, building an automation, analysing data or discussing priorities with stakeholders, you focus on creating solutions that are scalable, effective and user-friendly.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

    Experience from Go-to-Market Engineering, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a similar field
    Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, preferably HubSpot
    Experience building workflows, automations and commercial processes
    Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data into actionable insights
    A good understanding of B2B SaaS and commercial business models
    An interest in AI, automation and new technologies
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

You are comfortable working across teams and functions, enjoy taking ownership and thrive in an environment where collaboration, continuous improvement and learning are part of everyday work. Fluency in Swedish and English is required.

Who We Are

We are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.

We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.

Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.

What We Offer

We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.

Application

We are looking for a Go-to-Market Engineer located in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Hudiksvall, Näsviken, or Ljusdal.

The application deadline is 1st November 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Senior Business Analyst-Sales Air Content

title: Security Engineer, Core
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL

You? Empathetic with the people you work with, proactive about the work itself, and creative about how you solve it. Your passion is squashing bug classes at scale and helping developers without blocking them

Role? As a Security Engineer, you will own application security work end to end: bug bounty triage, code scanning, vulnerability management, and incidents. AI agents are a big part of how we scale that work. You will use them every day and help build new ones.

Tech stack? Our marketplaces run on Java/Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# and Go, and some teams even use Haskell. We run on AWS and GCP, and most apps deploy to Kubernetes. We build our agents with whichever models fit the job best

Location? Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, or Aarhus office with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA and Bilbasen. Around 500 developers deploy code to production several thousand times a week.

Why us? Most security teams are still deciding what to do with LLMs. We have spent a year running agents on production security work and measuring what actually helps. You will join while we are still working out the methods, and help shape them.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Security Experience: You have found and fixed vulnerabilities in real applications. You are comfortable in code you did not write, and can tell an impactful finding from noise.
    Engineering Background: You have shipped code to production. You would rather build the thing that prevents a bug class, or the agent that finds it, than write the report about it.
    Hands-on with AI: You already use LLMs in your daily work and want to push them further, by giving agents tools, context and harder problems. Experience building agents is a plus, but not required.
    Fast Learner: You pick up new, complex topics quickly. In this field, what worked six months ago might not be the best approach today.
    English Fluency: You write and speak English well. It is the working language across our teams in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Poland, and Finland.
    Education: A degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. We value different paths into security.

WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?

Day-to-day work

We used to automate with code. Now we automate with reasoning. Security scanners find patterns, but confirming a real risk takes investigation: tracing a request across services, finding who owns them, checking how they are exposed, reading logs, and testing whether an attack works. We are teaching agents to do more of that investigation, so you can spend your time on the findings that matter.

The Product Security Team

We are seven people spread across the Nordics, and we meet up regularly to work together. We are part of the Delivery Platforms area in Vend. Core Delivery Platforms helps Vend create real value by turning delivery into a trusted, measurable flow. We build composable, self-serve platform capabilities and provide services that reduce friction and power the flow that connects build, data, and AI, so ideas become outcomes faster.If you want to learn more about Emil and the team, you can follow this Link here: vend.com/news/inside-vends-product-security-team-a-year-of-ai-agents-on-our-production-systems

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by 25 October 2026. Please attach a CV and help us answer the pre-screening questions

QUESTIONS?

Emil Vaagland, Head of Product Security, is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role, you can reach out via email: emil.vaagland@vend.com. For the recruitment process and other topics, you can reach out to Clayton Don Corda, Senior TA Partner, via clayton.don.corda@vend.com

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

Troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and driving improvements in scalability, stability, performance and cost efficiency.

#LI-DNI

A university degree in engineering, IT, computer science or a related field.

    

Experience working in a larger cloud environment, such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

    

Comfortable working in Linux environments

    

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

    

Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

    

A good understanding of networking, cloud infrastructure and how different services communicate with each other.

    

Experience with CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.

title: Master thesis - Structural Analysis

As a person you are meticulous, ambitious, curios and eager to learn. Lastly, you also have good communicative skills, both oral and in writing, and can explain complex issues in a comprehensible manner.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.

Responsibilities

Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering

    Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
    Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
    Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
    Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.

Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation

    Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
    Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
    Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
    Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
    Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.

Feasibility & Technical Discovery

    Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
    Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.

Handoff & Platform Stakeholder

    Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
    Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
    Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.

Requirements

Must Have

    3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
    Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
    Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
    Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
    Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
    Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.

Nice to Have

    Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
    Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
    Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
    Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).

Benefits

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.
    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
At Lendo, we are on a mission to empower people to make smart, conscious financial decisions. We are entering an exciting growth phase, expanding our offerings to launch new products and help even more people navigate their financial journeys.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Product & Tech Sweden team, reporting directly to the Head of Product & Technology Sweden and joining the Product & Tech Leadership Team. In this role, you will lead and mentor our team of 3 UX designers and establish an elevated, user-first design culture across the company. You aren't just managing UI outputs you will champion service design, facilitate cross-departmental alignment, and shape holistic digital experiences that drive both user delight and business value.

About the role

As Lead Product Designer, you set the design vision and lead the end-to-end design practice across our ecosystem. You stay close to the daily design reality without micro-managing. You understand operational context, keep track of design deliverables, and step in to help your team navigate blockers, balance priorities, and refine their execution flow.

You combine empowering leadership with high standards for design craft. Whether coaching UX designers in deep problem framing, driving service design initiatives, or actively managing performance, you raise the bar for how design decisions are made across the company. You will be an integral part of the Product & Tech Leadership Team, working within a collaborative product-tech-design triad operating model.

Key Responsibilities

People, Leadership & Culture

    

Lead, mentor and coach a team of 3 UX designers, setting high standards for craft, feedback, and continuous learning.

    

Provide direction and clear guidance through regular feedback, development talks, and career progression planning.

    

Cultivate an inclusive, safe team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and craft excellence go hand in hand.

    

Manage performance, individual growth plans, and seniority adjustments in line with company frameworks.

Service Design & Cross-Functional Facilitation

    

Lead service design initiatives and facilitate cross-departmental discovery workshops to uncover root problems rather than build feature requests.

    

Partner closely with key non-design stakeholders (such as call agent managers and operations) to convert complex operational friction into intuitive software solutions.

    

Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders, and departments to resolve friction and align user needs with business value.

Design Strategy & System Leadership

    

Articulate the strategic value of a design system, leading its evolution, governance, and adoption to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across all digital touchpoints.

    

Champion user research and structured frameworks (such as the Double Diamond), compiling research into compelling narratives that articulate the "why" to secure organizational buy-in.

    

Collaborate within the Product-Tech-Design Leadership Team, partnering with Lead Product Managers and Engineering leads to align user needs with technical feasibility and business goals.

    

Explore and integrate modern workflows and AI-driven tools across design, prototyping, and front-end collaboration to accelerate discovery, iteration, and delivery.

About you

    

Experienced Design Leader: You bring at least 10 years of experience in digital product design, with at least 3 years of direct people management experience leading UX or Product Designers.

    

Master of Design Craft & Service Design: You have deep expertise in service design methodologies, end-to-end journey mapping, usability research, and modern frameworks like the Double Diamond.

    

Operational & Present: You stay close to the design flow, understand sprint dynamics, and support your team through both high performance and performance management needs.

    

Systemic & Strategic Thinker: You look beyond quick feature fixes to understand the broader ecosystem, articulating the strategic value of design systems and scalable user experiences.

    

Decisive & Compelling Communicator: You turn complexity into clarity, confidently navigating stakeholder discussions and inspiring teams through research-backed storytelling.

Ready to join us?

If you are a design leader who cares deeply about strategy, modern service design, and empowering high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

About the recruitment process

As part of our recruitment process, we may use psychometric testing through HI Assessments. We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.

We look forward to your application!

title: Professional Firmware Developer
description:
About the role

The Firmware Developer designs, builds and owns the firmware that runs on Kisi's access control hardware, from readers and controllers to video intercoms and wireless locks. Rather than shipping code and moving on, the role makes sure every device in our remotely managed worldwide fleet is secure, reliable and updatable, and that new products and features reach customers on quality.

Responsibilities

    Firmware development. Write and maintain robust firmware for current and future Kisi products on an industrial-strength embedded platform with built-in support for secure boot and OTA updates.
    Testing and fleet rollout. Define rigorous acceptance tests and, together with our QA engineers, supervise the rollout of new products and features to our global fleet of connected devices.
    Factory automation. Improve the efficiency of factory processes by automating flows such as quality assurance, device registration and labeling, so every device ships on quality.
    Security and reliability. Build firmware with security at its core, from secure boot and encrypted communication to safe OTA updates and recovery, so our devices can be trusted in the field.
    Platform selection. Take part in evaluating and selecting our next-generation IoT platform provider against strict security and business continuity requirements.
    Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with hardware, cloud, mobile and support teams to diagnose field issues, improve device performance and shape the product roadmap.
    Success looks like: Kisi devices around the world run secure, reliable firmware, updates ship smoothly, and new products reach customers on time and on quality.

Qualifications

    Strong proficiency in C for embedded systems
    Experience with microcontroller architectures (e.g. ARM Cortex-M) and peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I2C and UART
    Experience with real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS)
    Hands-on experience with embedded development tools such as J-Link, ST-Link, ARM-GCC and gdb, plus software tools like Git, Make/CMake and Python
    Understanding of secure boot, OTA updates and device security best practices
    Basic knowledge of assembly and Embedded Linux is a plus
    Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to own goals and see them through

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Zofingen liegt zentral im Aargau und bietet Sie mit ausgezeichneter Bahnanbindung zur Schweiz an. Die Stadt besticht durch ihre starke Industrietradition und vielfältige Arbeitgeber aus verschiedenen Branchen. Sie profitieren von günstigen Lebenshaltungskosten, kurzen Wegen und einer guten Work-Life-Balance in dieser attraktiven Wirtschaftsregion.

### Ihre Verantwortung als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Zofingen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das bringen Sie zwingend mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Zofingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Akutpsychiatrie in der Region Zofingen verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen, da Fachkräfte in diesem spezialisierten Bereich knapp sind. Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Project Manager (m/w/d) 100 % – Remote \& vor Ort
===================================================

e\-guma entwickelt seit 2005 digitale Lösungen für den Verkauf und die Verwaltung von Gutscheinen, Tickets, Produkten sowie Guthaben\- und Geschenkkarten. Heute nutzen über 1\`500 Kunden in 10 Ländern unser System. Was uns auszeichnet, ist die Verbindung von durchdachter Software und persönlichem Service. Wir arbeiten eng mit unseren Kunden zusammen, entwickeln e\-guma kontinuierlich weiter und setzen dabei auf einfache Prozesse und hohe Qualität. Bei uns arbeiten Hoteliers, Gastronomen, Touristiker, Marketingfachleute und Softwareentwickler Hand in Hand. Für unser Customer Care Team suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Project Manager.

**Deine Aufgaben**

* Als Project Manager begleitest du unsere Neukunden von der ersten Projektbesprechung bis zum erfolgreichen Go\-Live. Während des gesamten Onboardings bist du ihre zentrale Ansprechperson.
* Du planst und koordinierst die Einführung von e\-guma und berätst unsere Kunden zu Gutscheinen, Tickets, Produkten und weiteren digitalen Verkaufslösungen.
* Du klärst Anforderungen, konfigurierst die passenden Systeme und koordinierst Schnittstellen mit unserem Entwicklungsteam sowie die Aufschaltung von Online\-Zahlungsmitteln mit den beteiligten Partnern.
* Du richtest die verschiedenen e\-guma Systeme, Onlineshops und Zusatzlösungen ein, gestaltest Gutscheine und weitere Inhalte und achtest auf Corporate Design und Benutzerfreundlichkeit.
* Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Gestaltung effizienter Verkaufs\- und Verwaltungsprozesse und bereitest die Einführung vor Ort so vor, dass e\-guma reibungslos in den Arbeitsalltag integriert werden kann.
* Du schulst Neukunden im Umgang mit e\-guma – remote oder vor Ort – und unterstützt sie auch nach dem Go\-Live im laufenden Betrieb.
* Du berätst unsere Kunden bei Marketingmassnahmen und verkaufsfördernden Aktivitäten und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Angebote wirkungsvoll zu präsentieren und zu vermarkten.
* Du bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von e\-guma und unseren Prozessen ein.


**Das bringst du mit**

* Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung, bspw. im Bereich Tourismus, Hotellerie, Marketing oder im kaufmännischen Bereich.
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und gute Englischkenntnisse; ösisch und Italienisch sind von Vorteil.
* Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten.
* Freude am Kundenkontakt sowie eine klare, freundliche und lösungsorientierte Kommunikation.
* Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit hohen Mass an Eigenverantwortung.
* Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie Interesse an digitalen Produkten, technischen Zusammenhängen und individuellen Kundenlösungen.
* Sicherheit im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen und Freude an der Konfiguration von Systemen.
* Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln und Kunden kompetent zu schulen.
* Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Corporate Design; Kenntnisse der Adobe Creative Suite sind von Vorteil.
* Freude an der teamübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit.


**Das erwartet dich bei uns**

Bei e\-guma erwartet dich ein kollegiales, unkompliziertes und flexibles Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Du arbeitest im Homeoffice oder im Büro und profitierst von modernen Tools und flachen Hierarchien. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und unsere Produkte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten. Offene Kommunikation und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit – ebenso wie das gemeinsame Miteinander bei regelmässigen Apéros und Teamevents. In deiner arbeitest du mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen zusammen – von Hotellerie und Gastronomie über Bergbahnen, Bahn\- und Schifffahrtsunternehmen bis hin zu Freizeit\- und Erlebnisbetrieben, Eventveranstaltern, Detailhändlern und Organisationen.



Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

, Head of Customer Care

Bilfinger is an international industrial services provider with a vision to be the No. 1 for its customers in enhancing efficiency and sustainability within the process industry. Bilfinger’s comprehensive portfolio spans the entire value chain, from consulting \& engineering to prefabrication \& installation, access \& insulation, and services that improve the asset performance of industrial plants.







The company operates in three geography\-based segments: Western Europe, Central Europe, and International, with primary activities in Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Its process industry customers come from markets such as chemicals \& petrochemicals, energy, oil \& gas, and pharma \& biopharma. With about 31,000 employees, Bilfinger upholds the highest standards of safety and quality, generating revenue of €5\.4 billion in the financial year 2025\. To achieve its goals, Bilfinger has identified two strategic levers: Operational Excellence to continuously improve its own efficiency and performance, and Market Expansion to strengthen customer orientation and establish Bilfinger as the partner of choice.



Manager (m/f/d) \- Plant Engineering for Pharma / Biopharma Industry
====================================================================







Our experts in the business unit Life Science specialize in the planning and construction of state\-of\-the\-art process plants for the pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical industries, the semiconductor and battery industries, and the nutrition sector.







**We are Bilfinger Life Science**



* We practice open cooperation
* We support each other and celebrate our successes together
* We travel a lot and work on exciting international projects
* We promote professional and personal development






**Responsibilities as Manager**



* Evaluation and development of strategic accounts
* Further development of a sales pipeline based on systematic analyses (market, competition, customers)
* Ensuring order intake and revenue generation
* Expansion and maintenance of existing relationships with customers and planners within the EU sales territory and globally
* Implementation and further development of structured sales and marketing strategies
* Preparation and execution of contract negotiations, as well as creation of offers and agreements
* Regular reporting and revenue forecasting, continuous maintenance of customer and project data in the CRM system






**We are looking forward to meeting a candidate with**



* Preferably a completed higher education in business or engineering (e.g. University of Applied Sciences or Technical University), specializing in business administration, engineering, process engineering, or pharmaceutical engineering
* Relevant experience in the sales of plant engineering and piping construction projects, preferably in industries such as Pharma \& Biopharma
* Industry knowledge and/or an existing network with key decision\-makers in the above mentioned industries
* Strong presentation skills, negotiation skills, and closing ability
* Native\-level proficiency and business\-fluent English, both written and spoken
* High level of interpersonal skills and the ability to motivate oneself and others
* knowledge of contract law
* Proficient in MS Office
* Time flexibility and a high willingness to travel

Operations Specialist \- Electronic Monitoring
==============================================

**Title: Operations Specialist**

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Vacation:** 25 days annual holiday, plus local legal bank holidays. An additional day off on your birthday.

**Start Date:** Now



If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.



**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.



**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either , French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

*
* **Key Responsibilities:**


* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
* Support the delivery of training and knowledge sharing sessions, both upon request and by identifying areas for improvement.
* Support the completion of contractual obligations, such as the management of SLAs, KPIs, and the delivery of regular performance reports.
* Participate in regular account management meetings, capturing customer feedback and driving continuous service enhancements.
* Contribute to wider business development activities including supporting new customer implementations.




**Required Skills \& Experience:**

* Fluency in and English.
* A proactive, positive attitude with a passion for customer support and personal development.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Quick learner with the ability to understand and then explain Buddi’s products and services.
* Excellent attention to detail, particularly in billing and data accuracy.
* Competency with office\-based IT tools and software (e.g. Microsoft Office suite)
* Eligibility to work in Switzerland.




**Desirable Skills:**

* Previous experience in direct customer communication.




**Additional Information:**

* Buddi supplies its equipment to criminal justice agencies, therefore data security, confidentiality and security vetting are contractual necessities.
* Willingness to achieve any available high\-level security vetting is required.
* Compliance with all data security and confidentiality requirements, whether from Buddi or our customers, is a necessity.




If you’re passionate about customer success, detail\-oriented, and eager to contribute to a high\-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Bachenbülach liegt in der Zürcher Unterland und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Verkehrsanbindung. Die Region ist über die Bahn und Autobahn A1 leicht erreichbar und garantiert eine schnelle Anbindung an Zürich und weitere Wirtschaftszentren. Das Dorf überzeugt durch seine Nähe zur Natur, ein ruhiges Arbeitsumfeld und günstige Gewerbemieten, was es für Unternehmen besonders interessant macht.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Bachenbülach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Bachenbülach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Region Bachenbülach im Kanton Zürich verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern in Akutspitälern, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen weiterhin anhält und flexible Pensen zunehmend gefragt sind. - Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Schinznach suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schinznach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Schinznach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Schinznach liegt im Aargau zwischen Aarau und Olten und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung an die SBB-Hauptlinie sowie die nahegelegene Autobahn. Sie profitieren von der zentralen Lage in der Deutschschweiz und den kurzen Pendelwegen zu größeren Wirtschaftszentren. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Mischung aus ländlichem Charakter und industriellen Arbeitsplätzen mit guter Infrastruktur.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Schinznach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Schinznach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Die Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Schinznach ist derzeit sehr hoch. Als diplomierte Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH haben Sie ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere für leitende Positionen im Pflegedienst. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung und umfassende Unterstützung bei der Stellensuche in dieser gefragten Region.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Schinznach

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Schinznach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

Laufende Überprüfung und Analyse von bestehenden Prozessen und Erarbeitung von Optimierungsvorschlägen
